title: Sign in and reach the dashboard
description: This verifies that a returning user can submit valid credentials and reach the authenticated dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the dashboard is displayed

title: Block dashboard access without signing in
description: This verifies that an unauthenticated visitor cannot open the dashboard and is redirected or denied access to sign in.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user is blocked from the dashboard
Verify the sign-in page or access denial is displayed

title: Visit the home page and open the login page
description: This verifies that a visitor can move from the home page to the sign-in page using site navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to view the header navigation
Click the link to open the login page
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Visit the home page and open the courses catalog
description: This verifies that a visitor can discover featured content on the home page and navigate to the courses catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to view the featured courses section
Verify featured course content is displayed
Click the link to open the courses catalog
Verify the courses catalog is displayed

title: Visit the home page and open the lectures directory
description: This verifies that a visitor can discover featured lectures on the home page and navigate to the lectures directory.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to view the featured lectures section
Verify featured lecture content is displayed
Click the link to open the lectures directory
Verify the lectures directory is displayed

title: Visit the home page and open the registration page
description: This verifies that a visitor can move from the home page to the account creation page using site navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to view the header navigation
Click the link to open the registration page
Verify the registration page is displayed

title: Visit the home page and open the pricing page
description: This verifies that a visitor can review featured content on the home page and navigate to pricing information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to view the featured content sections
Verify featured content is displayed
Click the link to open the pricing plans page
Verify the pricing plans page is displayed

title: Create a new account and continue toward sign-in
description: This verifies that a new user can submit the registration form successfully and is guided toward signing in afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the email field with a unique valid email address
Fill in the username field with a unique username
Fill in the name field with a valid display name
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the sign-up form
Verify account creation success is visible
Verify a prompt to sign in is visible

title: Show a sign-in failure for invalid credentials
description: This verifies that the login form shows a failure message when a user submits invalid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or username field with invalid-user@example.com
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the sign-in form
Verify a sign-in failure message is visible

title: Show duplicate email validation during registration
description: This verifies that the registration form prevents account creation when the email is already in use.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the email field with an email address that is already in use
Fill in the username field with a unique username
Fill in the name field with a valid display name
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the sign-up form
Verify a duplicate email validation message is visible
